body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and gains +1 Fortitude against the next ranged attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: It resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
Protect a second willing creature adjacent to the first.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Golem
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Golem Full Manifestation (FM-1G). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
